title: 1.1 Dynamics II: collisions, explosions, recoil and rockets

q.Q1: Q1. A 3 kg trolley moving at 4 m/s hits a 1 kg trolley moving towards it at 2 m/s. They stick together. Find their common velocity.

q.Q2: Q2. For the trolleys above, calculate the kinetic energy before and after, and state the type of collision.

q.Q3: Q3. A 4 kg rifle fires a 0.02 kg bullet at 400 m/s. Calculate the recoil velocity of the rifle.
q.Q4: Q4. Why should a hunter hold the rifle butt firmly against the shoulder?

q.Q5: Q5. A rocket ejects 50 kg of gas each second at 2000 m/s. Calculate the thrust.
q.Q6: Q6. A force rises steadily from 0 to 60 N in 0.2 s and falls back to 0 in another 0.2 s as a ball is kicked. Find the impulse.

q.Q7: Q7. A 2000 kg matatu at 15 m/s hits a stationary 1000 kg car and they lock together. Find their speed just after impact and the kinetic energy lost.

q.Exit ticket: Exit ticket. Which quantity is conserved in all collisions?
